issues.issue: Was the officer's decision that the applicant did not show the NOC 4131 main duties reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Refusal letter applied the wrong test (essential duties, substantial number) and changed the criteria midstream without notice.
issues.respondent_position: not stated on the merits; respondent says factual findings get reasonableness review.
issues.result_quote: I conclude therefore that the decision of the Officer that the applicant failed to demonstrate that he met the requirements of NOC 4131

issues.issue: Should the officer have sent a fairness letter before refusing?
issues.applicant_position: A fairness letter was required to flag the evidence gaps before refusal.
issues.result_quote: I disagree. There is no requirement to issue a fairness letter or otherwise advise an applicant of the deficiencies in his application
